description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade ZavaAuthGateway from .NET Framework 4.8 to the latest .NET LTS target.
tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested modernization to the latest framework and this must precede cloud-native service changes.
tasks.requirements: Modernize the project to latest .NET LTS (net10.0), convert project structure as needed for modern build/runtime compatibility, and preserve authentication gateway behavior.

tasks.description: Modernize application dependencies and runtime integration to Azure cloud-native services.
tasks.reason: The user requested modernization to cloud-native services as part of Azure migration.
tasks.requirements: Adopt Azure-native service patterns for data/config/secret management and identity-based authentication where applicable for the Zava authentication gateway.

tasks.description: Scan dependencies for CVEs and remediate vulnerabilities before Azure deployment.
tasks.reason: Security/CVE remediation is required for every modernization plan.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and upgrade vulnerable dependencies to minimum patched versions while preserving application behavior.

tasks.description: Deploy the modernized ZavaAuthGateway application to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested deployment to Azure.
tasks.requirements: Containerize and deploy the upgraded application to Azure Container Apps with configuration and identities aligned to modernization tasks.
